title: C: versioned wire codec and dispatch admission
description:
Implement wire.12 in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/beacon.c and include/lichen/beacon.h, with applicable dispatch and fields in lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/messages.c and include/lichen/rpl_messages.h. Use bounded parsing and distinct version namespaces. Authenticate specified schedule/root/DODAG/generation/plan/profile and receiver/grant ownership before activation; malformed or legacy objects cannot partially adopt a CCP2 schedule.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse existing beacon/slot-map codecs rather than rewrite closed helper work. Coordinate b7z9.74 fields through this generic codec and zephyr.09 publication, without legacy-roll-up prerequisite edges. Keep public headers and host/native shims synchronized. Do not invent allocations, weaken legacy fixtures, repurpose SCHC/signature versions or edit audited OSCORE/EDHOC internals. Radio identity ownership and deferred portability remain unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Consume independent vectors.02 bytes/signatures through actual C codecs and dispatch. Cover truncation, duplicate/unknown fields, bounds, unsupported revision, wrong ownership/generation, expiry and unchanged state after rejection. Extend lichen/tests/tdma_beacon, lichen/tests/rpl_messages and routing-dispatch tests; exercise relevant parser fuzz entry points. Run host assertions/sanitizers/lint and TDMA-enabled local Linux/heft native tests qualified against the checked-in west pin, currently v4.1.0. No hardware ports or RF operation.
